title: Host genetics highlights IFN-gamma-dependent Toxoplasma genes encoding secreted and non-secreted virulence factors in in vivo CRISPR screens
paper_method: Per-gene fitness scores, WT-vs-KO and P4-vs-WT t-tests
model: Toxoplasma RH tachyzoites, ROP/GRA sublibrary (376 genes, 3,757 gRNAs), in vivo mouse passage
contrast: WT vs Ifngr1-/- mouse passage (20 vs 7); also in vitro (P4) vs WT (3 vs 20)
paper_calls: Fig 3/Table S1E: IFN-gamma-dependent virulence factors ROP5, ROP18, GRA12, GRA45
barcs_calls: WT vs KO: 71 genes at FDR 0.10 (70 depleted in WT); P4 vs WT: 140
named_hits: 4/4 at FDR<1e-10, top 4: GRA12 #1, ROP18 #2, ROP5 #3, GRA45 #4
verdict: BARCS ranks the four validated IFN-gamma-dependent virulence factors (GRA12, ROP18, ROP5, GRA45) as its top four depleted-in-WT genes; effect sizes correlate with the paper (r=0.32, 90% sign agreement on its top genes) but the heavily bottlenecked libraries and the paper's custom per-gene test leave the bulk p-value ranking uncorrelated.
